intro: The Adventurer is a brief quest set in Teldrassil involving the discovery of a discarded journal in the wilds. The plain notebook recounts the humble travels and camping outings of an unknown traveler, intended for delivery to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... Fun.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, hunter.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
